items.title: Generation as Reverse Encoding
items.snippet: Pretrained visual representations accelerate generative learning by abstracting away appearance and spatial detail. Yet the same abstraction makes the return to pixels far harder, shifting much of the burden onto a larger decoder. We ask why the representation-to-pixel path should be learned independently when the encoder already provides a learned pixel-to-semantics path (the semantic encoding path). We introduce RevFlow, based on the principle of generation as reverse encoding. RevFlow uses intermediate representations of a frozen encoder as successive generative targets, first generating deep semantic representations, then shallow representations that retain appearance and spatial detail,
items.title_ar: RevFlow: التوليد كترميز عكسي للصور
items.summary_ar: تقترح الورقة RevFlow مبدأ التوليد كترميز عكسي، حيث تستخدم التمثيلات الوسطية لـ frozen encoder كأهداف توليدية متتالية. تبدأ بالتمثيلات الدلالية العميقة ثم تنتقل إلى التمثيلات الضحلة التي تحتفظ بالمظهر والتفاصيل المكانية.
items.why_ar: يقدم نهجاً تدريبياً ملموساً لنماذج التوليد المبنية على encoders بصرية مدربة مسبقاً، وهو مفيد لأبحاثك.
items.title_en: RevFlow: generation as reverse encoding for images
items.summary_en: RevFlow uses intermediate representations of a frozen encoder as successive generative targets. It first generates deep semantic features, then shallow features that keep appearance and spatial detail.
items.why_en: It offers a concrete training approach for generative models built on pretrained visual encoders, relevant to your research writing.

items.title: When an AI agent makes a mistake in a database, what decides the damage?
items.snippet: AI agents now run statements against production databases, and several of the incidents that followed deleted production data, which came back only through backups or the provider's help. We ask what decides the damage when such an agent makes a mistake: the model, a guard layer in front of the database, or the database engine itself. The study has two preregistered layers. In Layer A, a frozen library of 22 canonical mistakes is applied by script, with no model involved, to four relational engines under five permission arms and two recovery arms, followed by an engine-native recovery drill (792 cells; 874 drill runs including 10-minute repeats). In Layer B, a minimal tool-calling agent driv
items.title_ar: AI agents تنفذ statements على production databases: ما الذي يحدد حجم الضرر؟
items.summary_ar: تدرس الورقة ما الذي يحدد حجم الضرر عندما يرتكب AI agent خطأ في database: الموديل، أو guard layer أمام قاعدة البيانات، أو محرك قاعدة البيانات نفسه. تطبق المنهجية مكتبة مجمدة من 22 خطأ شائعاً بالسكربت على أربعة relational engines مع خمسة permission arms وdrill للاسترجاع. وتضيف طبقة ثانية تختبر agent بسيط يعتمد على tool-calling.
items.why_ar: أي agent يكتب على قواعد بيانات الإنتاج في البنك يحتاج ضوابط حماية واسترجاع واضحة قبل النشر.
items.title_en: When AI agents hit production databases, what limits the damage?
items.summary_en: The paper asks whether the model, a guard layer in front of the database, or the database engine decides the damage when an AI agent makes a mistake. It applies a frozen library of 22 canonical mistakes by script to four relational engines under five permission arms and two recovery arms, followed by an engine-native recovery drill. A second layer tests a minimal tool-calling agent.
items.why_en: Any agent that writes to production databases in a bank needs clear guard and recovery controls before deployment.

items.title: Pretrained Tabular Features and the Measurement of Financial Proximity
items.snippet: Spatial arbitrage pricing theory (S-APT) extends factor models to allow returns to spill over between connected firms, beyond what common risk factors explain. In recent years, tabular foundation models (TFMs) have matched or outperformed tuned gradient-boosted and bagged ensembles on small and medium-sized tabular benchmarks. Although their predictive performance is strong, these models reveal little about what they have learned, which limits their use in regulated financial applications that require explanation. Internal representations are widely used to probe what neural networks learn and to measure similarity. In this paper, we use the frozen representations of four TFMs as a measure o
items.title_ar: Pretrained Tabular Features لقياس القرب المالي بين الشركات
items.summary_ar: تستخدم الورقة التمثيلات الداخلية المجمدة لأربعة tabular foundation models كمقياس للقرب بين الشركات ضمن نموذج Spatial arbitrage pricing theory. تشير الورقة إلى أن هذه النماذج تنافس أو تتفوق على gradient-boosted وensembles على benchmarks الجداول الصغيرة والمتوسطة. الهدف جزئياً هو تفسير ما تتعلمه النماذج، وهو مطلب في التطبيقات المالية المنظمة.
items.why_ar: يهم مهندس AI في البنك لأن تفسير النماذج الجدولية مطلب أساسي في التطبيقات المالية المنظمة.
items.title_en: Pretrained tabular features for measuring financial proximity
items.summary_en: The paper uses frozen internal representations from four tabular foundation models as a measure of proximity between connected firms in spatial arbitrage pricing theory. The models match or beat tuned gradient-boosted and bagged ensembles on small and medium tabular benchmarks. The work also aims to make these models more interpretable for regulated financial applications.
items.why_en: It is directly relevant to banking because tabular models need explanation in regulated financial use cases.

items.title: Reading, Not Adapting: Unlocking Frozen Visual Knowledge for AI-Generated Image Detection
items.snippet: Generalization to unseen image generators has driven efforts to adapt pretrained visual representations for detection. Yet recent findings show that vision foundation models already encode transferable detection knowledge, while further adaptation can impair generalization. This motivates a shift from backbone adaptation to knowledge readout. Conventional linear probing offers a direct way to read this knowledge but is limited to final-layer RGB features. Multi-cue detectors broaden the evidence base, but their designs introduce other tradeoffs: adaptation may compromise pretrained transferability, heterogeneous encoders complicate feature integration, and late fusion precludes intermediate
items.title_ar: كشف الصور المولدة بقراءة المعرفة البصرية المجمدة
items.summary_ar: تقترح الورقة تحويل كشف الصور المولدة بالذكاء الاصطناعي من تكييف الـ backbone إلى قراءة المعرفة الموجودة في vision foundation models المجمدة. وتنتقد linear probing المحدود بميزات RGB للطبقة الأخيرة، والكاشفات متعددة الإشارات بسبب فقدان القابلية للنقل أو تعقيد الدمج.
items.why_ar: كشف المحتوى الاصطناعي قد يفيد في سير عمل مكافحة الاحتيال والتحقق من الهوية، وهذا النهج أبسط من الـ fine-tuning المكلف.
items.title_en: Reading frozen visual knowledge to detect AI-generated images
items.summary_en: The paper argues for reading knowledge from frozen vision foundation models instead of adapting the backbone for AI-generated image detection. It critiques linear probing limited to final-layer RGB features and multi-cue detectors with adaptation or fusion tradeoffs.
items.why_en: Detecting synthetic images may help fraud and identity verification workflows, and this approach avoids costly backbone fine-tuning.

items.title: OS-Omni: Benchmarking Generalist Computer-Using Agents on Long-Horizon Workflows Across Platforms
items.snippet: Computer-using agents are increasingly expected to complete realistic user goals rather than isolated GUI actions. However, existing benchmarks typically isolate web, mobile, or desktop environments, leaving it unclear whether a single generalist agent can execute long-horizon workflows that span multiple operating systems and persistent application states. We introduce OS-Omni, a live cross-platform benchmark and execution environment for evaluating computer-using agents across Windows, Ubuntu, macOS, iOS, Android, and Web environments. OS-Omni is released in versioned waves of 300 tasks each; this paper focuses on the first release, v1, which contains 48 tasks per platform and 12 cross-pla
items.title_ar: OS-Omni: benchmark حي لتقييم computer-using agents عبر منصات متعددة
items.summary_ar: يقدم الباحثون OS-Omni، وهو benchmark حي وبيئة تنفيذ لتقييم computer-using agents عبر Windows وUbuntu وmacOS وiOS وAndroid وWeb. يحتوي الإصدار الأول v1 على 48 مهمة لكل منصة إضافة إلى 12 مهمة cross-platform. الهدف هو معرفة هل يستطيع agent واحد تنفيذ workflows طويلة المدى تمتد عبر أنظمة تشغيل متعددة مع حالة تطبيقات مستمرة.
items.why_ar: إذا كنت تبني agents تتحكم بالواجهات أو تريد قياس قدراتها، فهذا benchmark جاهز لاختبار workflows متعددة المنصات.
items.title_en: OS-Omni: a live cross-platform benchmark for computer-using agents
items.summary_en: The authors introduce OS-Omni, a live cross-platform benchmark and execution environment for computer-using agents across Windows, Ubuntu, macOS, iOS, Android, and Web. The first release v1 contains 48 tasks per platform plus 12 cross-platform tasks, with later waves planned at 300 tasks each. It targets long-horizon workflows that persist application state across operating systems.
items.why_en: If you build agents that operate GUIs, this gives you a ready environment to test long-horizon multi-platform workflows.

items.title: What a Forecasting Leaderboard Can Establish: Resolution Reporting for Zero-Shot Time-Series Models
items.snippet: A foundation model for time series is pretrained once and then asked to forecast series it has never seen, so the evidence for it is its score on held-out datasets. Such datasets are scarce, and a few public leaderboards carry most comparisons, yet none of them states how small a difference its datasets can detect. We call that quantity the resolution of a board and introduce Vernier, a tool that computes it from the files a board already publishes. Vernier also reports which entries a board cannot separate from its leader and whether its order changes when unrelated parties submit. GIFT-Eval resolves 6.8 rank places, and its displayed neighbours sit 0.91 apart. The ten places of its top ten
items.title_ar: Vernier: قياس دقة لوحات الصدارة لنماذج التنبؤ الزمني zero-shot
items.summary_ar: تقدم الورقة مفهوم resolution لوحات الصدارة، أي أصغر فرق في الأداء يمكن للوحة اكتشافه، وتطرح أداة Vernier لحسابه من الملفات المنشورة. تبيّن الورقة أن GIFT-Eval يميز بين 6.8 مراتب تقريباً، وأن الأماكن المعروضة متقاربة جداً. كما تقيس الأداة إن كانت الترتيبات تتغير عند إضافة مشاركات غير ذات صلة.
items.why_ar: إذا كنت تقيم time-series foundation models داخلياً، تساعدك هذه الأداة على فهم حدود مقارنات الـ benchmarks.
items.title_en: Vernier: measuring what forecasting leaderboards can actually distinguish
items.summary_en: The paper introduces the resolution of a leaderboard, the smallest performance gap it can detect, and presents Vernier to compute it from published files. It finds that GIFT-Eval resolves about 6.8 rank places and that its displayed neighbors sit very close together. Vernier also flags entries that cannot be separated from the leader and checks whether rankings change when unrelated submissions are added.
items.why_en: If you evaluate time-series foundation models, this tool helps you judge whether leaderboard comparisons are meaningful.

items.title: Guarding with Judgment: Learning to Intervene for Multimodal Safety
items.snippet: When visual context makes an ordinary request unsafe to answer as asked, a blanket refusal may leave the user's need unresolved. Choosing how to help requires distinguishing an established hazard from a condition that still needs verification, a distinction that binary safety labels leave unspecified. We formulate this decision through four actions: allow, warn, review, and refuse. To ground these decisions in verifiable evidence, we build a corpus of 20,126 training audits and the JudiBench benchmark, connecting each action to diagnostic judgments, source evidence, and controlled context changes. Our guard, JudiAct, separately states what the source establishes, what condition governs the h
items.title_ar: JudiAct: تعلم قرارات التدخل بين allow وwarn وreview وrefuse في multimodal safety
items.summary_ar: تقترح الورقة تفكيك قرار السلامة متعدد الوسائط إلى أربعة إجراءات بدلاً من الرفض الثنائي. بُني corpus من 20,126 training audits وbenchmark باسم JudiBench يربط كل إجراء بأحكام تشخيصية وأدلة مصدرية وتغييرات مضبوطة في السياق. يفصل الـguard المقترح JudiAct بين ما يثبته المصدر وما يتطلب تحققاً.
items.why_ar: أنظمة الـguardrails في البنك قد تحتاج قرارات أدق من السماح أو الرفض، خاصة مع المدخلات متعددة الوسائط.
items.title_en: JudiAct learns when to warn, review, or refuse in multimodal safety
items.summary_en: The paper replaces binary safety labels with four actions: allow, warn, review, and refuse. It introduces a corpus of 20,126 training audits and the JudiBench benchmark linking each action to diagnostic judgments and source evidence. The guard JudiAct separately states what the source establishes and what condition governs the hazard.
items.why_en: Bank guardrails for multimodal inputs may need graded intervention decisions rather than simple refusals.

items.title_en: Former Spanish central bank chief picked for ECB; BoE flags AI risks

items.title: sqlite3_rsync: Database Remote-Copy Tool For SQLite
items.snippet: sqlite3_rsync: Database Remote-Copy Tool For SQLite This additional SQLite tool has been around for a while now - it was added as "experimental" in SQLite 3.47.0 in October 2024 and enhanced in SQLite 3.50.0 in May 2025 . It was only today that I understood one of its most attractive characteristics. Normally, if you want to grab a snapshot copy of a SQLite database, you need to use either the backup API or VACUUM INTO . In both cases you need enough disk space to create a duplicate copy of your
items.title_ar: sqlite3_rsync أداة لنسخ قواعد SQLite عن بُعد
items.summary_ar: أداة sqlite3_rsync أُضيفت إلى SQLite كميزة تجريبية في الإصدار 3.47.0 وتحسنت في الإصدار 3.50.0. تتيح نسخ قاعدة البيانات عن بُعد دون الحاجة لمساحة قرص تكفي لنسخة مكررة كاملة، بخلاف طرق backup API وVACUUM INTO المعتادة
items.why_ar: قواعد SQLite شائعة في الـ POCs والأدوات الداخلية، وهذه الأداة تبسط النسخ والنقل بتكلفة مساحة أقل.
items.title_en: sqlite3_rsync: remote database copy tool for SQLite
items.summary_en: sqlite3_rsync was added to SQLite as experimental in 3.47.0 and enhanced in 3.50.0. It copies databases remotely without needing disk space for a full duplicate, unlike the backup API or VACUUM INTO.
items.why_en: SQLite is common in prototypes and internal tools, and this lets you snapshot and sync databases cheaply during POCs.

items.title: alesha-pro/llm.asm
items.snippet: Qwen3-0.6B inference (12 KB), bare-metal bootable OS (22 KB), and from-scratch Mini-GPT trainer with live Braille TUI (32 KB) in 100% pure x86-64 NASM assembly. Zero C, zero libc, zero dependencies.
items.title_ar: llm.asm: تنفيذ inference لموديل Qwen3-0.6B بالكامل بلغة assembly
items.summary_ar: ريبو alesha-pro/llm.asm يقدم inference لموديل Qwen3-0.6B في 12 KB، ونظام تشغيل bare-metal قابل للإقلاع في 22 KB، ومدرب Mini-GPT من الصفر مع واجهة TUI مباشرة. كل ذلك مكتوب بـ x86-64 NASM assembly دون C أو libc أو dependencies.
items.why_ar: يفيد في فهم تفاصيل inference على مستوى منخفض جداً، وقد يصلح مادة تعليمية أو مرجعاً لتحسين الأداء.
items.title_en: llm.asm: Qwen3-0.6B inference in pure x86-64 assembly
items.summary_en: The alesha-pro/llm.asm repo offers Qwen3-0.6B inference in 12 KB, a bare-metal bootable OS in 22 KB, and a from-scratch Mini-GPT trainer with a live Braille TUI. Everything is written in 100% x86-64 NASM assembly with zero C, zero libc, and zero dependencies.
items.why_en: It offers a low-level view of inference that can serve as an educational reference or a starting point for performance work.
